strings.en: I'll break through no matter what!
If I take out the Commander's unit...!
If I take that one down, I can open a way through!
I'll kill you with my own hands!!
You killed Al! You killed my comrades!/　Now pay for it!
Looks like you haven't noticed you were lured in...!
Sorry, Elma! I don't think I can make it!
A direct hit at the worst possible time?!
I can't die without knowing/　what happened to the captain and the others!
Serena, damage is in the danger zone!
As long as this unit moves, I won't give up...!
Not yet! I won't end here!!
Enough! I'm not backing off until I beat that one!
They can have a plate or two of armor!
I have to do something while it's just scratches...!
Not to the likes of you...!
I won't die until I've beaten you!
Like I'd just let myself get hit!
Let's get out of here, Elma!
They're all ganging up on me!
That one moves differently from the others...!
Right now, a single hit could be fatal...!
Don't relax! The next one's coming!
How unlike me. Looks like I made a silly mistake.
Just watching the enemy go/　doesn't feel good...
A mistake at a time like this?!
So it's outside my weapons' range...
Reading my range like that... No ordinary pilot.
I need to change position right away...!
Guess you didn't notice me in your blind spot!
I won't let you run wild in front of me!
I'll take you all out at once!
I'll make sure of the kill!
You don't have to tell me!
You can't... escape from this one!!
